title: Bones
description:
S01 E14 — The Man on the Fairway
At the scene of a plane crash involving Chinese diplomats, Brennan finds three small bone fragments that did not come from the plane and might have something to do with a local man who went missing five years earlier.

title: Bones
description:
S01 E15 — Two Bodies in the Lab
Brennan tries online dating but ends up the target of a shooting when she tries to meet her date at a local restaurant.

title: Bones
description:
S01 E16 — The Woman in the Tunnel
When the remains of a filmmaker are found in the ventilation shaft of an underground tunnel, Brennan and Booth discover a subterranean world of homeless people.

title: Bones
description:
S01 E17 — The Skull in the Desert
The investigation of the bones of a shooting victim leads to a counterfeiting ring.

title: Bones
description:
S01 E18 — The Man With the Bone
When a body is found clutching a 300-year-old finger bone, Booth and Brennan's investigation leads them to a dive site where a pirate may have buried his treasure.

title: Bones
description:
S01 E19 — The Man in the Morgue
Brennan wakes up in the bathroom of her New Orleans motel room, bloodied and beaten with no memory of what happened.

title: Bones
description:
S01 E20 — The Graft in the Girl
While examining a young girl's cancer, Brennan and Booth uncover a bone-smuggling ring.

title: Bones
description:
S01 E21 — The Soldier on the Grave
Booth and Brennan's investigation of an apparent suicide of a protester in Arlington National Cemetery may lead to a military scandal.

title: Bones
description:
S01 E22 — The Woman in Limbo
Brennan makes a shocking discovery while trying to identify a Jane Doe; Brennan tries to come to grips with her parents' past.

title: Bones
description:
S02 E01 — The Titan on the Tracks
Brennan and Booth investigate the site of a train wreck that includes the bodies of a senator and a high-profile businessman.

title: Bones
description:
S02 E02 — Mother and Child in the Bay
The remains of a woman and fetus are found in the Delaware Bay; Brennan and Booth call for a manhunt for the victim's husband; Booth has issues with his ex-wife's boyfriend.

title: Bones
description:
S02 E03 — The Boy in the Shroud
Wrapped in a shroud, the body of a young man lies beside an overturned garbage truck; Brennan's past as a foster child influences her judgment; Brennan and Cam butt heads over their work styles; Cam makes threats.

title: Bones
description:
S02 E04 — The Blonde in the Game
Brennan and her team match wits with a serial killer to save a girl's life.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S04 E19 — High Stakes
Percy and LaSalle go undercover at a high-stakes poker game after the organizer targets players with access to a naval research laboratory; Laurel Pride visits her dad during spring break to discuss options after her upcoming graduation.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S04 E20 — Powder Keg
Pride and his bar patrons are held hostage by a group of volatile thieves.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S04 E21 — Mind Games
Gregorio calls on her former behavioral science professor when the team's latest case matches one she studied during FBI training.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S04 E22 — The Assassination of Dwayne Pride
A journalist posts a scathing article documenting Pride's "reckless use of justice"; the team is concerned about the fallout from the piece and the confidential information revealed; Rita Devereaux tells Pride it is a coordinated attack on him.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S04 E23 — Checkmate, Part I
Pride assembles an off-the-books team to search for a loophole when he faces a grand jury indictment for abuse of power.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S04 E24 — Checkmate, Part II
Pride's teams uncover a sinister plot during the New Orleans Tricentennial Fleet Week celebration.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S05 E01 — See You Soon
While Pride fights for his life in the ICU, the team scours the city for the hit woman who attempted to assassinate him.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S05 E02 — Inside Out
The team searches for a former Irish Republican Army bomb maker who was smuggled into the city; they are joined by agent Hannah Khoury, Pride's replacement during his medical leave; Pride considers a new position within the agency.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E05 — A'ohe Mea 'Imi a Ka Maka
On Halloween, Jerry and his friends search his childhood camp for evidence to a murder he witnessed as a boy; McGarrett investigates a little girl who drew pictures depicting the scene of a recent murder before it was discovered.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E06 — Aia I Hi'ikua; I Hi'Ialo
McGarrett crosses the line and is arrested while investigating the death of his former SEAL buddy who died while making an emergency landing on an aircraft carrier; Adam returns to Oahu with devastating news about his marriage.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E07 — Pua a'e La Ka Uwahi O Ka Moe
McGarrett investigates a cold case that his grandfather and the famous Honolulu detective Chang Apana worked on in the 1940s; McGarrett and Danny get ready for the opening of their restaurant.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E08 — Lele Pu Na Manu Like
Grover's parents and brother arrive in Oahu for Thanksgiving; a thief is crushed to death by an empty safe.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E09 — Mai Ka Po Mai Ka 'Oia'i'o
When a renowned urban vigilante is killed after making a citizen's arrest, the team delves into the world of superheroes and comic books to find the killer; Adam gets closer to finding out who killed his sister.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E10 — Pio Ke Kukui, Pō'ele Ka Hale
After fighting off an assassin in his own home, McGarrett and Joe White flee to Montana to prepare for a battle against those exacting revenge for a past SEAL mission.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E11 — Hala I Ke Ala O'i'ole Mai
Still reeling from the murder of one of their own, Steve and Catherine, along with Danny, Junior and some old friends, hunt down the killer; a bag of human bones discovered inside an abandoned storage locker goes missing.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E12 — Ka Hauli O Ka Mea Hewa 'Ole, He Nalowale Koke
McGarrett and the team support Danny and Rachel by determining what happened when Grace gets into a life-threatening car accident; Tani helps Koa when his rehab patient goes missing.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E13 — Ke Iho Mai Nei Ko Luna
Adam, Junior and Tani travel to the bottom of the Pacific Ocean when a murder takes place in a remote underwater lab -- and the killer may still be on board.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E14 — Ikiiki i ka la o Keawalua
While investigating Flippa's friend's murder, McGarrett and Grover uncover a deadly plan by an extremist group on the Island; Grover has an emotional reaction to the case.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E15 — Ho'opio 'ia e ka noho ali'i a ka ua
As a dangerous hurricane hits Oahu, Five-0 is tasked with protecting El Diablo, a captured serial killer who is being hunted by an assassin; Tani's civilian safety check during the storm turns deadly; Rachel and Charlie evacuate to Danny's house.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E16 — Hapai ke kuko, hanau ka hewa
When the top salesperson for a beauty company pyramid scheme is murdered, the team sifts through a long list of possible suspects who would want her dead; Adam befriends a homeless man.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E17 — E'ao lu'au a kualima
Junior is torn between his duties and his feelings for his former girlfriend when her new man is one of the culprits in a bank heist-turned-homicide.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E18 — Ai No I Ka 'Ape He Mane'o No Ko Ka Nuku
Tani and Junior go undercover at a gym to track down a deadly batch of steroids; Danny and McGarrett work as bodyguards for Danny's high maintenance ex-mother-in-law, a famous romance novelist with whom he has never gotten along.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E19 — Pupuhi Ka He'e O Kai Uli
The team investigates the murder of a window washer and finds that the victim is actually a renowned street artist; Grover and Adam look into the murder of a gambler; Junior helps his father when they are reminded of his sister's death.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E20 — Ke Ala O Ka Pu
When the team must locate a girl who purchased a gun from a junkie, it discovers that the firearm, over the course of decades, has affected all the teammates' lives.

title: The Listener
description:
S04 E04 — Cold Storage
Toby and Michelle search for a killer suspected of taking national defense secrets.

title: The Listener
description:
S04 E05 — Buckle Up
Toby goes undercover to find a group of thieves posing as police officers.

title: The Listener
description:
S04 E06 — Witness for the Prosecution
Toby and Michelle investigate a potential conspiracy linked to a mob murder trial.

title: The Listener
description:
S04 E07 — Caged In
After witnessing the death of an MMA fighter, Toby looks into the business dealings of two rival leagues.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S02 E17 — Radio Silence
A Navy captain is murdered during an appearance on a local radio show; Pride's daughter comes home to talk about her plans for the future.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S02 E18 — If It Bleeds, It Leads
Agent Brody sees a connection between the case of a sailor struck by a party bus and the death of her sister; the team gets ready for the city's St. Patrick's Day celebrations.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S02 E19 — Means to an End
After Pride's daughter is attacked on campus, the team finds a surveillance van loaded with pictures of the special agent's every move.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S02 E20 — Second Line
The team investigates when a Navy lieutenant is murdered during a traditional funeral procession in the French Quarter honoring the recently deceased.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S02 E21 — Collateral Damage
When a Navy lieutenant dies during a secret visit to a general's hotel, agent Pride and the team are asked to break protocol for the investigation.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S02 E22 — Help Wanted
While visiting her family's restaurant in the French Quarter, a Navy culinary specialist is the target of an explosion; in D.C., Brody tracks a lead in the Gen. Leak case.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S02 E23 — The Third Man
NCIS teams with Homeland Security when the murder of a Navy master diver is discovered to be linked to the chatter concerning a foreign attack on the city.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S02 E24 — Sleeping With the Enemy
The NCIS team discovers a mole in the ranks while helping the Department of Homeland Security locate 900 pounds of missing explosives that are a threat to New Orleans.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E01 — Aftershocks
The team joins forces with several federal agencies to stop a sniper who has been targeting crowded events in the city; FBI Special Agent Tammy Gregorio begins investigating Pride's team.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E02 — Suspicious Minds
Pride faces more repercussions from the FBI after he helps a former Navy Intelligence Analyst who is the primary suspect in a multiple homicide case.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E03 — Man on Fire
After the discovery of a petty officer's body inside a sports arena, evidence leads Pride and the NCIS team to a kidnapping case of another petty officer, last seen in Mexico.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E04 — Escape Plan
The NCIS must come to the rescue of one of its own when Sebastian is kidnapped while dining in a restaurant with his mother; Sebastian relies on his gaming skills in a prison break.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E05 — Course Correction
The NCIS and the FBI investigate a private plane crash in the bayou that killed three sailors; Sonja and LaSalle interview candidates for a job opening on the team.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E06 — One Good Man
A Navy SEAL candidate is murdered weeks before his graduation; Wade seeks Pride's help when her adopted son announces his plan to join the Navy.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E07 — Outlaws
A sailor is murdered during a rowdy motorcycle rally in the city; LaSalle seeks personal advice from Gregorio.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E08 — Music to My Ears
After a member of the United States Navy Band is murdered in her home, Pride looks after the victim's nephew, who is the only witness to the crime.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E09 — Overdrive
The NCIS team investigates when a Marine corporal who is an amateur race car driver is in a fatal crash on the track.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E10 — Follow the Money
Pride needs to protect a family friend engaged to the prime suspect in an ongoing NCIS and FBI cartel case.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E11 — Let It Ride
Sebastian goes undercover; Patton practices his old gambling skills; Pride and the team embark on a perilous plan to trap Garcia.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E12 — Hell on the High Water
After Pride travels to a deep-sea oil rig for a murder investigation, the team uncovers a gas leak that's on the verge of causing a catastrophic explosion; Sebastian starts his NCIS special agent training.

title: FBI: Most Wanted
description:
S03 E14 — Shattered
The team pursues an abusive man who is on the hunt for an ex-girlfriend trying to escape him; Jess and Sarah make plans to take their dream vacation together.

title: Bull
description:
S01 E10 — E.J.
Bull tries to help a CEO whose company is accused of killing an employee with its self-driving car, but a secret emerges that could sabotage a trial win.

title: Bull
description:
S01 E11 — Teacher's Pet
An attorney for one of Bull's former clients asks him to consult on a couple's civil suit against a teacher who had a sexual relationship with their son; the trial strategy suffers a major setback when the teen switches to the teacher's side.

title: Bull
description:
S01 E12 — Stockholm Syndrome
The wife of a man whom Danny helped imprison for manslaughter detonates a bomb at the TAC offices and takes the team hostage to force Bull to prove her husband's innocence.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S06 E24 — Pa'a Ka 'Ipuka i Ka 'Upena Nananana
Five-0 tries to protect a wounded Gabriel and plan an escape when enemy gunmen storm the dilapidated building in which Gabriel is trapped.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S06 E25 — O Ke Ali'I Wale No Ka'u Makemake
McGarrett and Danny pose as drug pilots in a plan to stop a meth epidemic on the island; Danny is forced to break cover and land the plane when McGarrett is seriously wounded.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E01 — Makaukau 'oe e Pa'ani?
The team hunts for a murderer who has been targeting serial killers, marking their corpses with an ivory chess piece.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E02 — No Ke Ali'i Wahine A Me Ka Aina
A rogue MI-6 agent is the key to finding a terrorist who plans to cause the meltdown of nuclear reactors across Europe; McGarrett and Danny need the help of an FBI profiler to find a killer.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E03 — He Moho Hou
After finding a corpse in her bed, FBI profiler Alicia Brown joins McGarrett in a hunt for a killer; Kono reconnects with a former surfing competitor.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E04 — Hu A'e Ke Ahi Lanakila A Kamaile
When the serial killer that Alicia and McGarrett have been hunting kidnaps them, it's up to Five-0 to find them before it's too late.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E05 — Ke Ku 'Ana
A cache of guns is stolen by a person looking to make a statement on gun violence; Kono and Adam are reunited.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E06 — Ka Hale Ho' Okauweli
On Halloween, the team investigates the murder of a medium who was apparently frightened to death by a poltergeist; a mysterious death cult kidnaps Kono and Adam.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E07 — Ka Makuahine A Me Ke Keikikane
Catherine informs Five-0 that McGarrett's mother has been captured and is in danger of being executed for trying to free Wo Fat's imprisoned father; Chin is unable to delay Sara's adoption.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E08 — Hana Komo Pae
While Danny chaperones Grace's high school dance, the venue is seized by terrorists, who hold everyone hostage with the intent of abducting a diplomat's son; Danny and Grover discover that Will is Grace's secret boyfriend.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E09 — Elua La Ma Nowemapa
A conspiracy theorist with compelling information that JFK's own cabinet planned his assassination is murdered.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E10 — Ka Luhi
A boy suffering from PTSD undergoes hypnosis and realizes he may have witnessed a murder related to a 10-year-old cold case; Danny's sister visits Oahu.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E11 — Ka'ili Aku
The team rushes to Mexico, where Chin puts his life in jeopardy in an effort to rescue Sara, his kidnapped niece.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E12 — Ka 'aelike
When Chin is kidnapped by a Mexican cartel, Five-0 must rescue him before he is executed by the vengeful group; Grover goes undercover to investigate a murder, which turns out to be far more complex and dangerous than anticipated.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S04 E09 — Hau'oli La Ho'omaika'i
A Secret Service agent is murdered while the president is traveling to Oahu; as Thanksgiving approaches, McGarrett's Aunt Deb (Carol Burnett) visits and shares a stunning secret.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E08 — Lele Pu Na Manu Like
Grover's parents and brother arrive in Oahu for Thanksgiving; a thief is crushed to death by an empty safe.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S10 E09 — Ka la'au kumu 'ole o Kahilikolo
Junior and Tani track down the thief who robbed his parents' home; Five-0 investigates the murder of a beloved philanthropist and the theft of his valuable koa tree; Danny moves in with McGarrett.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E13 — Ho'i mau na 'opua i Awalua
While Max prepares to say his goodbyes, the team investigates a murder during a police convention on the island.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E14 — Ka Laina Ma Ke One
The team faces a contentious U.S. Marshall after a murder suspect escapes capture and looks for asylum in the sovereign land that belongs to the Nation of Hawaii.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E15 — Ka Pa'ani Nui
While working a murder case, Five-0 discovers that a former Nazi war criminal may be hiding out in an old leprosy colony in Hawaii.
